brand.name: DBL (Dominican Big Leaguer)
brand.description: Not on the site at all - confirmed absent from the site's full 112-brand index, and NOT related to 'Dunbarton Tobacco & Trust,' which IS a separate, unrelated listed brand (checked explicitly to avoid conflating the two). 'DBL' stands for 'Dominican Big Leaguer' - a baseball-themed boutique brand founded by Francisco Almonte, made at the company's own Dominican Republic factory, active since at least 2016 with a continuous release history through PCA 2026. Why it's absent from the site's index is unconfirmed - possibly an index gap, or it may be filed under 'Dominican Big Leaguer' elsewhere.
brand.founded_note: Active releases documented from at least 2016 (IPCPR) through 2026; a precise founding year was not found in sources reviewed.
